title: Prediction Inference for Hybrid Models on Realized Volatility Forecasting
idea: Each day, train an ARMA‑GARCH‑LSTM hybrid on the past 250 days of realized NQ volatility (log of NQ high‑low range) and use the forward‑bootstrap algorithm to generate a 5‑day prediction interval for realized volatility; then go long a 5‑day NQ straddle when the interval width exceeds its 20‑day moving‑average, scaling position size by the interval width.

title: From Black-Scholes to Jump-Diffusion: A Narrative Review of Option pricing Model Evolution
idea: Use the 7‑day/30‑day IV term‑structure (term column) as a proxy for jump intensity: when term > 1 (steeper short‑term IV), bias a delta‑neutral straddle trade toward buying OTM puts (expecting jump‑down risk).
